The Codex of 50 Pages is a grand challenge issued to the chosen of Shao Daraan, summoning them from all of time and space to the City of Stories to take on the challenge of climbing the 50 pages to the end of the Great Book. 
Adventurers from throughout the ages have been summoned, bound into groups and given the mission to climb the pages, for whatever they desire resides within, and what they desire most lies at the top, the last page, reach the cover of the great book. 

The first of the challenge is the beginning, the first page, the birth of the City of Stories, inhabited by the celestial and the dimension wanderers, for 5 months now new individuals have been appearing, populating the city, seemingly unable to leave they begin lives, but many would not settle for their new astral prison. 


## FLOORS: 
- [[Floor 1, The City of Stories]]: The first floor, a safe hub, the city is filled with merchants, taverns, shops, and merry making, the only truly safe place in the entire Great Book. It contains the dungeon called "The Gateway" that leads to the next page.
